en-US.author: Florian Rival
en-US.description: The fastest, easiest, most powerful no-code game engine.
en-US.longDescription: GDevelop is a free, open-source game engine that's 10x easier and faster to use than anything else. Build from anywhere — even on your phone. Publish everywhere: iOS, Android, Steam, web, gaming platforms. Reach millions of players or create the next hit game you've been dreaming of.
en-US.name: GDevelop
en-US.releaseNotes:
💝 Improvements
- Gold & Pro premium subscribers now get every month a free game template to claim, in addition to a free asset pack.
- Education subscribers now get a free seat: the plan holder is not counted toward the seat total anymore.
- Bundles, game templates and asset packs can now be bought as a gift. Once purchased, forward the email or the activation link to gift the product.
🐛 Bug fixes
- Fix performance issue on Windows/some GPUs by disabling stencil buffer resolution in render targets.
- Fix applying image smoothing changes to the scene editor.
⚙️ Extensions
- [Community][Playgama Bridge]
  - Multiplayer (SaaS): new bridge.multiplayer module for real-time games
  - Platform updates (Y8: integration updated to the new Y8 SDK, MSN: SDK update, player avatar, ad fix, YouTube: ad block detection fix, Playgama: support for social methods)
- [Reviewed][3D terrain] Make the ground faster to draw on slower graphics cards (v0.2.0)
  - Also add an advanced "Anisotropic filtering" property (4x by default, as before).
🎨 Assets
- New effect packs for objects & layers
- Add 3 new audio packs from Elv
  - Add the Electronic Game Music Pack
  - Add the 8-BIT Battle Music Pack
  - Add the 16-BIT RPG Music Pack
🕹 Examples
- Add a new free 3D Air Hockey example
- Use the new 3D actions/conditions in the 3D tank, haunted house and GTA starters
- Stop the expanded 3D starters from freezing while boxes move, and load them faster
🕹 Premium Game Templates
- Update the game template: Advanced Transitions by Vegetato
  - Fixed a bug where using multi transitions in the same scene causes the
    extension to create huge amount of shape painter instances.
  - Fixed an issue where shape painter object instances stays in the scene
    after the transition has finished.

zh-CN.author: Florian Rival
zh-CN.description: 最快、最简单、最强大的无代码游戏引擎。
zh-CN.longDescription: GDevelop 是一款免费的开源游戏引擎，使用起来比其它任何引擎都要简单和快速 10 倍。在任何地方都能创建，甚至是在手机上。在任何地方都能发布：iOS、Android、Steam、网页和游戏平台。与数百万玩家见面，或制作下一款你梦寐以求的热门游戏。
zh-CN.name: GDevelop
